title: Adaptive Training
definition: The process of fine-tuning a language model using a sequence of steps, including SFT (Scaled Factorized Training) and DPO (Deep Parameter Optimization), to improve its performance on specific tasks or domains.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Training a computer model in stages to make it better at understanding and generating human-like text, especially in specific contexts.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Applying a combination of Scaled Factorized Training and Deep Parameter Optimization to improve a language model's performance on specific tasks or domains, such as chat conversations or non-chat outputs.
difficulty_levels.expert: Utilizing a multi-stage training process that combines Scaled Factorized Training and Deep Parameter Optimization to enhance a language model's understanding of specific tasks or domains, while simultaneously addressing issues from the previous implementation.

extra_fields.insight: Developing an adaptive training methodology to improve the performance of language models, tailoring them to specific tasks or domains.
